decisions.reason: Proves v0.9.5 absent from mirror via ls-remote capture and branch-only sync push; ties to immediate attempt-1 ref-resolution failure and rules out network/typo with evidence.
Compat table + dsh-version.txt show v0.9.7 built for newer alpha.1 API on older rc.2 host lacking useConversation; install success/restart explained as irrelevant to API fit.

R2 selects v0.9.3 with rc.1 real-boot verification and additive rc.2 note, notes v0.9.3 also missing from mirror, gives #v0.9.3 install conditional on maintainer tag push, SHA fallback kept unverified/uninvented; freeze honored.
Adds per-mirror tag push in the sync loop plus per-mirror ls-remote verification gate and tag-set reconciliation; grounded in the branch-only script.

Gives a per-host-version compatibility matrix routing rc.1/rc.2 to v0.9.3, but the alpha.1 row points to a future re-cut v0.10.0-alpha.0 rather than stating alpha.1 users can use v0.9.7; core routing requirement met, that element is absent.
